issue.title: TUI onboarding doc links point at 404 pages sase.sh/macro/ and sase.sh/patch/
issue.description:
Two TUI onboarding "learn more" links point at sase.sh pages that do not exist.

- `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/agent_onboarding.py:27` `_MACRO_DOCS_URL = "https://sase.sh/macro/"` -> 404. The page is `docs/macros.md` (`/macros/`).
- `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/patch_onboarding.py:29` `_PATCH_DOCS_URL = "https://sase.sh/patch/"` -> 404. The page is `docs/change_spec.md` (`/change_spec/`).

Root cause: bulk terminology renames rewrote the URL string literals along with identifiers, but the docs pages were never renamed and no redirect was added:
- `c7026e50ef` (2026-08-08, "feat(tui): rename ACE patch surface") introduced `https://sase.sh/patch/`.
- The xprompt->macro sweep (`5541d4c697` 2026-10-03 / `6320828878` 2026-10-04) produced `https://sase.sh/macro/`. `docs/_redirects` only maps `/xprompt/` -> `/macros/`.

Fix options: point the constants at `/macros/` and `/change_spec/`, or add `/macro/` and `/patch/` redirects in `docs/_redirects` (or `mkdocs.yml` redirect_maps). Either way, add a test that every `https://sase.sh/...` URL literal in `src/` and `README.md` resolves to a page (or redirect) in the built site, so future renames cannot silently break in-product doc links.

Found during the sase.sh docs redesign research (research:202610/sase_sh_docs_redesign/sase_sh_docs_redesign__final.md, §1 and §6.6 item 6).

task_type_fields.impact: Users who click the TUI agent or Patch onboarding Learn-more link land on a 404 page instead of the macros or Patches docs.
task_type_fields.repro: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://sase.sh/macro/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://sase.sh/patch/  (both print 404 on 2026-10-15; /macros/ and /change_spec/ print 200)

issue.creation_reason: Found while auditing sase.sh docs links for the docs redesign research; in-product Learn-more links send users to 404s and nothing validates sase.sh URLs in code.

payload.entry: Fixed by epic sase-1le phase sase-1le.2 (fd8adfbe9b) and retargeted by sase-1le.19: agent_onboarding.py and patch_onboarding.py now link https://sase.sh/concepts/prompts/ and /concepts/work-units/. docs/_redirects carries '/macro/ /macros/ 301' and '/patch/ /change_spec/ 301' for released builds. No src/ literal still names sase.sh/macro/ or /patch/, and just docs-check passes the URL contract (3,284 URLs) at master 3e950ebdbd. Verified by the sase-1le land agent.
